description.value: Sporty Bar & Grill is a long-running pub and restaurant at the northern tip of Vancouver Island, a natural terminus for cyclists completing or starting an island tour. Head Chef Chris Purvis has led the kitchen for over eleven years, offering Pacific seafood, handhelds, and bi-weekly rotating features with European flair. The venue has been voted 'Best Food in Town' in Port Hardy for four consecutive years.

address.value: 8700 Hastings Street, Port Hardy, BC, V0N 2P0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at sportybar.ca is fully fetched and provides reliable primary evidence: address, phone, and business identity are clearly stated across multiple subpages. The in-house menu explicitly labels several items 'Gluten free' and 'Vegetarian,' confirming dietary options. The homepage notes 'EV chargers available,' which refers to electric vehicle (car) chargers, not e-bike charging infrastructure, so e-bike charging remains null; no other cyclist-specific amenities (bike racks, Wi-Fi, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM name is 'The Sporty Bar & Grill' but the website consistently uses 'Sporty Bar & Grill' (without 'The') — minor discrepancy.
OSM record contains no address or phone tags; both were sourced exclusively from the website.
Website mentions 'EV chargers available' (electric vehicle car chargers) — not confirmed as e-bike-compatible; may warrant follow-up if the directory tracks EV charging separately.
OSM record has minimal tags beyond amenity and name, limiting cross-validation of any amenities.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Well-established pub and restaurant at a key cycling waypoint in Port Hardy; active website with current menu and consistent contact details confirms the business is operating and would serve touring cyclists well.
